about.text: Iced milk tea is Hong Kong-style milk tea served cold, in cha chaan teng and bottled or canned in convenience stores. It is chilled with ice cubes, by standing the cup in an ice-water bath, or, the slowest and now uncommon way, by cooling the tea in a glass bottle in the fridge.
